intro: Algerian culture mixes Amazigh, Arab, Ottoman, French and African influences.

chapters.title: Raï and chaabi
text: Raï music, born in Oran, was made world-famous by Khaled. Chaabi is the popular music of Algiers.

chapters.title: Food
text: Couscous is the national dish. Chakhchoukha, rechta noodles and mint tea are favourites.
